jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Application & Platform Security
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

- Be the offset.   We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

- What would it take?  We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

- It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS *

- Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

- Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

- Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

- And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

- Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Security & Infrastructure PMO, dedicated to our Application Security and Platform Security teams in Long Beach. You will be the embedded program management partner to these two teams, driving execution from intake through delivery, running their operational rhythms, engaging with cross-functional software engineering teams, and keeping leadership's view of commitments and risk current and honest.

Application Security owns the security of the software we build: secure development practices, product and application security programs, vulnerability management, and the controls that keep our codebase and pipelines defensible. Platform Security owns the security of the environments that software runs in: cloud and platform security, identity and access management, infrastructure hardening, and the operational processes that keep those domains healthy. Your job is to make both teams more predictable and more effective—turning technical work into tracked, milestone-oriented programs and surfacing conflicts before they become delivery problems. It is also part engagement manager and part product manager: the company's software engineering teams are App Security and Platform Security's customers, and you help understand their needs and shape how security capabilities are delivered back to them.

This is a dedicated role, but not a static one. Your primary charter is Application Security and Platform Security, and that is where you'll build the deepest context. As portfolio priorities shift, you should expect to flex across other Security & Infrastructure programs when the PMO needs it, bringing the same execution rigor wherever you're pointed.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own end-to-end delivery for Application Security and Platform Security initiatives—building and maintaining the program plans, milestone schedules, and dependency maps in Jira, and driving them from intake through close
- Run both teams' operational cadences—sprint/backlog grooming, weekly status, and quarterly planning—and keep backlog health and ticket hygiene good enough that status is trustworthy without a fire drill
- Partner with the team leads on effort estimation, task decomposition, and resource alignment across concurrent workstreams; surface capacity conflicts and schedule risk early, with options
- Serve the software engineering teams as the primary customers of App Security and Platform Security—intake their requests, set expectations on what security can deliver and when, and keep that channel active rather than reactive
- Manage cross-functional dependencies with software engineering, IT, GRC, cloud/platform, and external vendors and assessors
- Produce leadership-ready program visibility—milestone-oriented, risk-flagged, and current—including the roll-ups and tear-sheets the PMO uses for steering
- Partner with the PMO Lead on roadmap planning: prioritization, capacity planning, and keeping the plan of record maintained as priorities shift
- Flex to other Security & Infrastructure programs as portfolio demand requires, bringing the same execution discipline to an unfamiliar domain

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years combining application and platform security with the technical program management of that work—deep in at least one domain (secure SDLC, vulnerability management, CI/CD pipeline security; cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management), credible in the other, with a track record of owning and running programs end to end
- Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent workstreams with cross-functional dependencies and external stakeholders
- Strong Jira or equivalent proficiency; able to build and maintain structured tracking across multi-team portfolios
- Comfortable operating where scope, priorities, and assignments shift with portfolio demand
- Clear, direct communicator; able to simplify complex status for executive audiences and push back when warranted
- U.S. citizenship required; clearable required

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- Prior experience as an information security engineer who has since moved into technical program management (preferred over a TPM background without hands-on security experience)
- Familiarity working directly with software engineering and platform/DevOps teams
- Familiarity with NIST RMF, FedRAMP, or federal compliance environments
- Experience in defense technology, aerospace, or DoD contractor environments

COMPENSATION

- Base Salary:  $140,000-$210,000

- Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be  determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

- Work Location —Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

- Work environment —the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

- Physical demands —the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite
To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice .

You will work directly with the US Space Force and other USG customers to define requirements and drive strategic capability development. You will also work cross-functionally across engineering, cyber, legal, and finance to ensure the product meets both external and internal business needs. You will own the implementation strategy, translating user needs into detailed product requirements, working closely with engineers to deliver capabilities that meet user needs. Your ability to think like a user while speaking the language of developers will be key to your success.

- Partner with customers, business development, and engineers to define product functionality, shaping scope where requirements are thin or evolving, and prioritize features based on business goals and technical feasibility

- Engage directly with the US Government to align expectations, continually solicit feedback, and earn trust to partner with the customer to guide the roadmap

- Own scope trade-offs between product vision and delivery capacity, making prioritization calls when needed

- Create clear, actionable requirements, epics, and other specifications that guide engineering execution

- Map and document user workflows, data flows, and system dependencies to ensure a full-stack understanding of product behavior

- Define and track success metrics, gathering feedback and iterating quickly to improve outcomes

- Partner with technical program management and engineering leadership to keep the backlog aligned to current priorities

- Provide transparent, concise program updates to executives and partners with clarity and technical precision through documentation, dashboards, and presentations

QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years of product management or technical product ownership experience

- Proven experience working directly with external customers and earning trust with peers

- Experience delivering against competitive, milestone/demo-based government contracts (down-selects, phased prototype OTAs, etc.)

- Experience working with cloud-deployed architectures, containerized software, web-based applications, developer tools, and data products

- Ability to visualize and communicate complex data and user workflows

- Experience writing technical documentation, PRDs, or system specifications

- Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal

- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development practices

- Technical background (e.g., degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant work experience)

- U.S. Citizen

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- Knowledge of the US Space Force’s approach to Battle Management and associated doctrines

- Knowledge of the ATO process and NIST Risk Management Framework

- Hands-on experience with cloud deployments, containerized software, web applications, or similar platforms/infrastructure/applications

- Background in systems engineering or technical program management

- Experience working on space-related programs (e.g., Battle Management, SDA, satellite operations, RPO training, or electronic warfare)

- Active or eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance

COMPENSATION

- Base Salary: $135,000-$235,000

- Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

YOUR MISSION

True Anomaly is seeking a Technical Program Manager, Payloads with a hardware development background and a passion for building mission-critical systems that support space superiority. In this role, you will serve as the owner of program execution for payload development and integration. You will drive clarity, alignment, predictability, and accountability across payload engineering, spacecraft systems, software, manufacturing, test, security, and program office teams. You will lead complex payload programs from requirements definition through design, development, qualification, production, integration, and operational deployment. You will also manage vertical integration projects that connect payloads with the spacecraft bus, flight software, ground systems, launch operations, and mission architecture.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at the intersection of technical execution and program leadership. You will proactively manage risk, resolve cross-functional dependencies, guide tradeoffs, and create the structure required to deliver cutting-edge systems in a high-ambiguity, fast-paced environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of payload development and integration programs.

- Own program execution by defining delivery plans, managing scope and milestones, and driving accountability across engineering and cross-functional teams.

- Manage vertical integration projects supporting payloads, including interfaces with spacecraft systems, flight software, ground systems, manufacturing, test, launch, and mission operations.

- Serve as the primary delivery interface among payload engineering, systems engineering, production, security, and program office stakeholders.

- Translate mission and product requirements into actionable technical plans in partnership with engineering and program leadership.

- Coordinate payload development across the full lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, design, procurement, build, test, qualification, acceptance, and delivery.

- Drive interface definition and control across payloads and the broader space system; identify gaps, assumptions, and integration risks early.

- Participate in technical and architectural discussions, ensuring decisions support mission needs, delivery timelines, security requirements, manufacturability, and system reliability.

- Manage and resolve cross-team dependencies across engineering, production, security, test, launch, and program office teams.

- Maintain an accurate, real-time dependency map, integrated master schedule, risk register, and decision log for assigned programs.

- Plan and coordinate integration and test activities, including development testing, environmental testing, qualification, acceptance, end-to-end testing, and operational readiness.

- Proactively identify and manage risks, tradeoffs, and blockers; escalate issues and recommend decisions when schedule, scope, technical performance, or resources are misaligned.

- Track program performance using execution metrics such as milestone performance, schedule predictability, technical maturity, defect trends, test readiness, and release readiness.

- Maintain program dashboards and status reporting so stakeholders have timely, accurate information to inform decisions.

- Establish effective operating rhythms, including technical interchange meetings, program reviews, risk reviews, integration planning sessions, and executive updates.

- Drive continuous improvement in program execution, development processes, and cross-functional collaboration.

- Thrive in a high-ambiguity environment by creating structure, clarity, and alignment where needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of experience in technical program management, systems engineering, hardware development, or a related technical field.

- Understands the hardware development process and has experience delivering complex hardware or aerospace systems through development, prototype, test, production, and integration.

- Strong technical understanding of relevant space or defense systems, including satellites, spacecraft payloads, sensors, communications systems, missile defense systems, rockets, engines, or related technologies.

- Experience managing cross-functional programs involving hardware, software, systems engineering, manufacturing, test, and operations.

- Experience with system integration, interface management, verification and validation, or end-to-end test planning.

- Experience with Jira, Confluence, and other program or engineering execution tools.

- Deep familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid development processes.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience working on classified Department of War programs or other relevant national security programs.

- Active Secret clearance required; TS/SCI preferred.

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment with shifting priorities and incomplete information.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Background in aerospace, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

- Experience managing payload development or spacecraft payload integration.

- Experience with spacecraft-to-payload, payload-to-ground, or other mission-system interfaces.

- Experience with integration and test campaigns, environmental qualification, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or end-to-end mission testing.

- Experience managing suppliers, subcontractors, or external technical partners.

- Experience with Power BI or other data visualization and program analytics tools.

- PMP, Agile, or other relevant program management certification.

- Experience working in a cleared, classified, or export-controlled environment.
